sections.heading: style-126 · Stained-Glass Light Projection — 3 s silent preview

children.value: ; scene redraws from timeline state on every update and on

rows.Beat: Dim stone: cool hemisphere light on gray stone; rose window glows faintly. Copy "I · ONE PANE OF LIGHT", "An idea", "becomes a connected system." fades in on the right.
Blackout: hemisphere, fill and window glow go to 0; stone falls to the #101216 field.

Light up: spotlight behind the window ramps up, its angle narrows to fit the window, and it swings so the jewel projection (ruby/sapphire/gold panes, dark leading, mullion shadows) moves across the floor. "II · CAST ACROSS THE STONE" appears at 1.7 s.

children.value: Full video (not in preview): white bloom finale (bloom strength + light intensity ramp) and camera moves.
Approximation: projected texture + shadow map, not physical refraction or caustics.
